description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

InnoVision Marketing Group is hiring a Web Developer to build, maintain, and optimize client websites, primarily using WordPress. The role collaborates with development, design, strategy, SEO, and marketing teams on responsive digital experiences, technical SEO, performance, and department improvements.
Web Developer building and maintaining WordPress and Shopify sites, custom functionality, e-commerce, and technical SEO/performance

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain WordPress websites, including custom themes, templates, and functionality
• Write clean, efficient, well-structured code across front-end and back-end environments
• Build and support Shopify websites and e-commerce functionality
• Contribute to custom website development beyond traditional CMS templates when required
• Troubleshoot coding issues, bugs, and website performance challenges
• Optimize websites for speed, performance, usability, and scalability
• Implement technical SEO best practices, including site structure, crawlability, and performance
• Ensure websites function properly across browsers, devices, and screen sizes
• Collaborate with designers to translate creative concepts into responsive, functional digital experiences
• Maintain code quality, version control, and technical documentation
• Support website updates, enhancements, and maintenance
• Keep current with development tools, technologies, and best practices
• Collaborate with developers, designers, strategists, and other team members
• Participate in meetings, brainstorming, and project discussions; share ideas, knowledge, and constructive solutions
• Help teammates troubleshoot, approach feedback with an open mind, and communicate project progress or challenges proactively
• Understand the marketing strategy behind websites and the value of collaboration across development, design, strategy, and marketing
• Identify ways to improve website functionality, performance, and user experience
• Research and test emerging web technologies, tools, platforms, and AI capabilities; evaluate their potential to improve efficiency and results
• Recommend useful tools, workflows, and development practices, and share discoveries with teammates and leadership
• Improve processes without compromising quality, take initiative in solving problems, and bring creative solutions
• Go above and beyond when needed and help foster curiosity, learning, and innovation across the department
• Participate in team meetings and collaborative work sessions
• Manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
• Support teammates and departmental priorities while maintaining a positive, professional workplace

Requirements:
• We're looking for a talented, collaborative  Web Developer  who enjoys coding, solving technical challenges, and improving websites
• Personality, attitude, and a genuine desire to be part of a team are equally important
• We want someone positive who collaborates, contributes ideas, welcomes challenges, solves problems, and improves processes
• We value enthusiasm for emerging tools, platforms, and AI-driven development, along with initiative to explore, test, and learn new technologies independently
• This role suits a junior-to-midlevel developer seeking a long-term career in a growing, integrated marketing organization
• WordPress expertise is required
• Junior-to-midlevel professional web development experience
• Strong WordPress development experience
• Experience building and customizing WordPress themes, templates, and functionality
• Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP
• Understanding of responsive design and modern front-end development practices
• Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and improve existing code
• Understanding of website performance optimization and technical SEO fundamentals
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
• Ability to manage multiple projects and meet established deadlines
• Strong communication and organizational skills
• A positive, collaborative personality and genuine enthusiasm for working as part of a team
• Willingness to share ideas, contribute to improvement, learn emerging technologies and AI tools, and demonstrate initiative, accountability, and professional growth

Preferred:
• Experience with Shopify, custom development, technical SEO, and website performance optimization is highly valued
• Shopify development and e-commerce experience
• Custom website development beyond standard CMS platforms
• Experience optimizing website speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance
• Experience in an advertising agency, marketing agency, or multi-client development environment
• Familiarity with SEO tools, analytics platforms, and website performance reporting
• Experience collaborating with design, strategy, and digital marketing teams
